summary: Frontend-only layout testing (desktop 1920, tablet 768/1023, mobile 390) via Playwright on public URL. Nearly all requirements pass: / -> /process redirect, all 4 routes in layout with header+footer, active nav (text-primary + aria-current), sticky header, breakpoint visibility (announcement md+, desktop nav lg+, hamburger <lg, sticky bar <md), PrequalButton nav/mobile/primary href/target=_blank/rel='noopener noreferrer'/label 'Pre-Qualify'/svg after text, header/footer/mobile/sticky CTAs -> /contact#get-started and scroll to #get-started below the sticky header, footer socials (6, new tab, noopener), legal links href='#', copyright text exact, FooterLegal comment present, no iframes, no console errors, no horizontal overflow, footer legal bar ends exactly at sticky bar top (not hidden). Found 2 minor bugs, both about navigation within the same pathname.

ui_bugs.issue: Mobile menu does not close when the target has the same pathname as the current page. It only closes on a pathname change (useEffect deps [pathname]). Repro at 390px: on /contact open the menu and tap 'Get Your Dream Car' (/contact#get-started). The URL and scroll update, but the menu stays open and covers the screen. Same thing happens when you tap 'Contact' while on /contact#get-started, or 'The Process' while on /process.

Clicking a Get Your Dream Car CTA a second time when the URL is already /contact#get-started (after scrolling back to the top) does nothing, because pathname and hash are unchanged so the effect does not re-run. scrollY stays 0.

action_items: Header.jsx: close the mobile menu on every navigation. Either add onClick={() => setOpen(false)} to the MobileMenu links and CTA (pass an onNavigate prop), or key the effect on location.key / [pathname, hash].
SiteLayout.jsx useScrollOnNavigate: add location.key to the effect deps so repeat clicks on /contact#get-started scroll to the section again.
critical_code_review_comments: site.phoneHref is the placeholder '[TEL LINK]' (not a tel: URI). Replace it before launch; all phone links currently point to a relative path.

The review request lists the test id 'legal-link-build-foundation-28', but the actual ids are legal-link-privacy-policy / terms-of-use / consumer-disclosures / accessibility. This is a typo in the request, not a code issue.
frontend/.env REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL is build-foundation-28.preview.emergentagent.com, while the request mentioned a 2c20ef0c... URL. Testing was done on the .env URL.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Layout verified at 1920/1023/768/390. Pages are placeholders, so desktop pages are short; inject a tall div to test the sticky header. Re-check that the mobile menu closes on same-path navigation and that repeat CTA clicks scroll to #get-started.
rca of the issue: Header useEffect(() => setOpen(false), [pathname]) ignores hash and same-path navigation. SiteLayout scroll effect depends on [pathname, hash] only, so re-navigating to an identical URL does not trigger it.
